newsitem.title: NORWAY: Den norske Bank extends BNBank deadline.
newsitem.headline: Den norske Bank extends BNBank deadline.

text.p: Den Norske Bank said on Friday it has extended its deadline for shareholders in BNBank to accept DnB's bid for all BNBank's shares until May 12.
DnB, Norway's largest bank, is locked in a bidding war with the country's fourth largest bank, Fokus Bank, for niche mortgage lender BNbank.

"The reason for the extension is that the extraordinary general meeting in BNbank on Wednesday afternoon rejected Fokus Bank's demand that the two banks enter into merger negotiations," DnB said in a statement.
"DnB's cash off is thus the only offer still in force."
Earlier on Friday, Fokus Bank said its offer to BNbank shareholders remained on the table.
"Fokus Bank hereby confirms that the proposal to merge with BNbank stays firm," it said in a statement.

"We base this on BNbank board's decision of not to refuse merger negotiations with Fokus Bank, but rather to delay the assessment of our proposal while the bid from DnB is being considered by the market," Fokus said.
